propositions: Operators lack visibility into plan-material-pin drift, enforcement status, and phase compatibility in detailed review surfaces without adding noise to list output or persisting warning events.

Multiple detailed renderers (CLI show, MCP detail, audit output, close errors, web UI) must consume the same DerivedPlanReviewHealth contract to display normalized pin status, fingerprints, missing-target state, and enforcement effects.
Pin enforcement-disabled state must be displayed as advisory drift while legacy-unpinned cases remain distinguishable and ordinary list output and persisted events remain unchanged.

Audit rendering must call compute_validity within build_context assembly after audit_trail completes, with graceful error handling that logs failures and renders derived-health unavailable without changing allow/deny semantics.
Output schemas and rendering tests must be updated to cover pins, phases, enforcement toggles, deleted targets, and close-versus-claim freshness with backward compatibility.
